## Objective

Make the completion rules in TRD-20261118-666F5516 verifiable in the reusable guidance, its mapped Template and the active Sys4AI depot. Start from the recorded adoption, retain conforming files and correct any demonstrated gap.

User value: A user gets usable advice, a verified repair or the supported part of a blocked request without an avoidable extra turn. A coordinator can tell exactly what a worker delivered and what still needs an owner.

### Success outcomes

- Every approved requirement has current evidence from the relevant guidance, behavior or preservation check.
- Ordinary prompts exercise the documented-command, recoverable-failure and missing-source cases. Skill output and delegated handoffs honor their own contracts.
- The source, Template and depot satisfy their respective checks, with attributable results for current governance bindings and protected files.

## Scope

### In scope

- The completion section in the reusable and depot souls, the Director and general worker contracts, the three specialist pairs and the communication skill.
- Source-to-Template distribution, scoped depot adoption and the existing tests, role indexes and local governance bindings affected by those exact files.
- Three ordinary-prompt checks, a focused communication-format check, ownership and stop checks, and a per-criterion final review using current evidence.

### Out of scope

- Ordinary product changes or setup, deployment, external publication or communication, Git push and unrelated working-tree cleanup.
- Creation, activation or mutation of a managed Task. Model or reasoning-effort changes, a scheduler, new dependencies or a new execution service.
- Rewriting historical release records, expanding grants or weakening the approval and stopping rules of existing skills.
- A completion-rate benchmark or a claim about untested products, hosts or scenarios.

### Execution authority

The current request authorizes creating this draft from the approved TRD. Creating, approving or tracking a plan does not authorize implementation or any separately governed action. Execution and native qualification require separate current authority for the exact plan.
